Professional Oversight

Transparency is at the core of our management philosophy. We provide regular updates and clear reporting, keeping you informed of progress and milestones at every stage. With Unique Building Contractors managing your project, you can have peace of mind knowing that your investment is being protected by experienced professionals dedicated to excellence.

Frequently Asked Questions

What does construction management include?

Services can include scheduling, budget planning, resource and trade coordination, quality assurance, risk management, subcontractor oversight, and stakeholder reporting tailored to the project type and scope.

How are project updates communicated?

The management process includes regular progress updates and reporting tied to project milestones, active issues, and schedule status — with a single point of contact responsible for communicating with the owner throughout.

Can you manage multiple trades?

Yes. Trade coordination — scheduling, sequencing, and quality oversight of multiple subcontractors — is a core part of the construction management service.

Does construction management include permit coordination?

When Unique Building Contractors serves as the licensed contractor of record (CBC1268844), permit filing and inspection coordination with the applicable local authority are included as part of the management scope. Specific responsibilities are confirmed during project planning based on the project type and jurisdiction.
